Not a sheet of glitter: the bubbles are big, round and separate
Avoid: small numbers get lost in the dots, reads busy on large flat panels.

articles.title: Ghost Camo
articles.summary: User-coloured satin surface with a subtle low-contrast ghost camouflage pattern hidden in the clearcoat; shown in a pale neutral preview. Reads as your plain satin colour; only a faint cloudy camo shows up in reflections when light rakes across it, and from a distance it is nearly invisible.

articles.title: Ghost Circuit
articles.summary: Glossy panel with faint rectangular circuit-trace lines buried in the clearcoat, only catching light at an angle. Almost invisible: the panel reads as a plain glossy colour with a faint cold, digital mottling in some angles.
articles.what: Circuit board traces in clearcoat — hidden tech lines revealed under angled light Up close: On the neutral grey test input the pattern is a barely-there cluster of blocky traces: short horizontal tick marks stacked in small ladders, 10-40 px, with some vertical dashes, in a slightly cooler blue-grey than the ground. They group into irregular rectangular patches like a data readout or. From a distance: Almost invisible: the panel reads as a plain glossy colour with a faint cold, digital mottling in some angles. when: Best on: body, hero panel, hood.
